tasks.title: Secure FFmpeg render worker lifecycle
acceptance: Owned source asset registration and hash-verified staging
Durable render job state with lease fencing and crash recovery
Allowlisted FFmpeg binary and argv-only execution; no shell or arbitrary URLs
Bounded input size, clip count, CPU, memory and runtime
Audio mixing and ffprobe output validation
external_gates: Production filesystem isolation and resource limits
implemented_increment: Workspace-scoped private asset staging with server-side SHA-256, size limits, quarantine state and hash verification on access
Immutable normalized EDL v1 snapshots with database update/delete guards and workspace authorization
Idempotent timeline_render queue handoff carrying snapshot ID, digest and normalized EDL
Lease-fenced timeline worker with heartbeat, generation-token checks and review_pending completion
Shell-free FFmpeg audio-mix argv builder with bounded tracks, trims, fades, gain and limiter
Regression tests for asset isolation, snapshot immutability, queue handoff, worker transitions and audio argv validation
Lease-fenced checksum-verified render artifact adoption with workspace-scoped immutable records and atomic review_pending handoff
Worker integration and regression coverage for stale generation rejection, snapshot binding, private staging boundaries, byte limits and artifact tamper detection
remaining: Connect a real scanner and ffprobe probe; persist trusted media duration and reject source trims beyond actual duration
Integrate audio mixing and video rendering into a concrete EDL renderer that produces staged MP4 outputs
Run pinned FFmpeg and ffprobe binaries in an isolated worker container with CPU, memory, disk, network and process-count quotas
Add real-media integration tests and crash/lease-loss tests against the production runtime
Expose authenticated upload, render submission and review APIs with production filesystem permissions and retention cleanup
